children.title: Tinkercad login code
children.content:
https://www.tinkercad.com/joinclass/

The class code is TW7-UDZ-CTN - Type this in the box. 

Fill in the information. Do not give your correct birthday. If it asks for an email use mine -

deborah_woodlock@roundrockisd.org

This should take you to Woodlock's Gateway 2024-2025. Book mark the link.

Then logout and log back in choosing Student Login with Google.

children.title: Journal Set UP
children.content:
You will write you name and class period on the outside cover with marker.

You will write you logins on the inside cover.

You will again write your name and class period on the 1st right page - next to the cover. 

Step 2: Turn the page.

 

You will add your backpack to the left side. 

You will write Design and Modeling - 1st Semester on the 2nd right page.
